verified_facts.text: The hotel is a base for outdoor activities in Montjuic, the Joan Miro museum, the Mies van der Rohe Pavilion and the Fira Barcelona Convention Center.

verified_facts.text: The 173 Rooftop Terrace has a swimming pool, views, drinks and Mediterranean flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: A new 360 setting featuring a swimming pool, views, drinks, and authentically Mediterranean flavors.

verified_facts.text: From the rooftop guests can see Barcelona from the Torre de Collserola and Tibidabo to the Montjuic cable car, the Sagrada Familia, the cathedral and the Palacio Nacional.
verified_facts.excerpt: You will be able to view the whole of Barcelona from the Torre de Collserola and the Tibidabo to the Montjuic cable car, the Sagrada Familia, the Torre de Agbar, the cathedral, Plaza España, and the Palacio Nacional.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop has a glass swimming pool and panoramic views.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop terrace is seasonal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal 173 Rooftop Terrace

verified_facts.text: The interior common areas are airy, with high ceilings and statement art pieces.
verified_facts.excerpt: the chic and airy interior common areas, with their high ceilings and statement art pieces, are those of a modern lifestyle hotel
